# ShopSharp

> ShopSharp is a Nigeria-focused marketplace where buyers discover products and contact sellers directly, and sellers create online shops.

## Marketplace

- Homepage: https://shopsharp.com.ng/
- Browse products and shops: https://shopsharp.com.ng/browse
- Seller registration: https://shopsharp.com.ng/create-your-shop

## Pages

- Shop pages use the format https://shopsharp.com.ng/shop/{shop-slug}.
- Product pages use the format https://shopsharp.com.ng/listing/{listing-id}.
- The sitemap is available at https://shopsharp.com.ng/sitemap.xml.

Shop and product availability may change. Public listing details are provided by their sellers; verify details directly with a seller before making a purchase.
